notes.title: Demo v1.0 released!
notes.content: [h1]What was done:[/h1][p][b]Added Music[/b][/p][p][b]Replaced and added sounds[/b][/p][p][b]Rebalanced enemies and weapons[/b][/p][p][b]Improved graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Redone some sprites, animations[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Replaced old 3D models[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added new 3D Models[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New skybox[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New menus and fonts[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed and improved all locations[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added HUD[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Further changes will be based on feedback and feedback, the goal is to make a great game![/h3]
